symptom: Repair v6 passed schema and static gates but failed the 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke matrix. RandomBot rose to 33.3%, CowardBot fell to 0.0%, GreedyXpBot and KiteBot rose to 100.0%, BossHunterBot fell to 33.3%, and RouteBot rose to 66.7%. Only IdleBot, TankBot, and ZoneControlBot stayed inside target bands.
root_cause: The v6 anti-kite pressure increased sprinkle-spitter frequency and durability while leaving its XP value high, so high-skill and greedy builds converted the extra pressure enemies into faster leveling. The bubble-shoes nerf also reduced BossHunter stability without sufficiently limiting KiteBot's damage and XP snowball.
fix: Do not promote v6. The next repair should keep the ZoneControl caramel payoff, but reduce ranged-pressure XP yield, avoid broad mobility nerfs, and use pressure changes that challenge safe movement without becoming extra economy for high-skill Bots.
validation: The next candidate must rerun 300s / 3-seed all-Bot smoke before any 10-seed expansion. A viable result should keep RandomBot at 0%-15%, CowardBot and RouteBot at 10%-35%, Greedy/Tank/ZoneControl at 25%-55%, and Kite/BossHunter at 45%-75%.
